g.text: 1. BASE: 3×12mm Baltic birch (1-sided CNC, Ø6mm endmill, R≥3.5mm) + 6mm steel lid & 2×10mm bars (1.06 kg).
2. TURRET: Ø30/Ø11mm hollow walnut dowel in Ø30.2mm bore; integral 60° birch stop lug (±90°–120°).
3. ARMS & SHADE: 6mm laser birch (A2 SVG: 0.025pt black cut / red fill etch); 50/50 flush half-lap ribs.
4. ANTI-SPIN JOINTS: DIN 603 M8×50 / M6×35 carriage bolts in square holes + fender + Belleville + Nylon 6/6.
5. ELECTRICS: 12V DC Class III SELV, base PWM rotary dimmer, 22 AWG braided cord, 2700K G45 E27 LED.
6. VERIFICATION: 16/16 FreeCAD B-Rep zero-overlap PASS; worst-case tipping FoS = 4.09 fwd / 2.05 @ 90°.
7. FDM 3D PRINTS (PETG/TPU): Vented E27 carrier, trapped DC bezel, PCB cradle/insulator, grommets, feet.
ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETERS · UNSPECIFIED TOLERANCE: CNC ±0.15 mm · LASER ±0.10 mm (KERF COMP)
